messages:
Aisha: Quick summary from the postmortem: last-night the cloud control-plane in eu-west-2 returned intermittent 5xx on token exchange which cascaded into model-registry write failures and a brief spike in inference errors. We need concrete mitigation owners and dates.
Tom: Saw the same. Root cause looks like provider auth throttling combined with our synchronous metadata flush job. I can take the write-side mitigation (batching + async flush). ETA: proto PR Tue.
Ravi: I'll own auth client resilience. Plan: token cache with optimistic refresh, jittered refresh schedule, and circuit-breaker on repeated 5xx. ETA: Thu EOD.
Clara: Ops will add a cross-service alert for 5xx ratio + registry write latency and attach the runbook. I'll also add a daily digest to the vendor-availability channel for 2w. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Aisha: Good. Also add a recurring review to spot patterns: monthly vendor-dep cadence + weekly short pulse for the next 6 weeks. Who takes the weekly?
Tom: I'll take the first two weeks of the weekly pulse, then hand over to Ravi.
Ravi: Sounds good. I'll also prepare a short checklist for the pulse: recent deploys, vendor incident correlation, spike patterns, and action status.
Clara: Ops-bot: create tickets for the three deliverables.
ops-bot: Created: [CPL-712] "Registry async flush + batching" assigned to Tom (due 2026-04-07). https://jira.redwood/CPL-712
ops-bot: Created: [AUTH-503] "Token cache + jittered refresh + circuit-breaker" assigned to Ravi (due 2026-04-09). https://jira.redwood/AUTH-503
ops-bot: Created: [OPS-221] "Vendor availability pulse + alerting" assigned to Clara (due 2026-03-30). https://jira.redwood/OPS-221
Aisha: For risk-reduction, let's enable an emergency fallback path: if registry writes fail with >=3 consecutive errors, route inference to last-known-good model snapshot (read-only) for up to 15 minutes. This reduces error surface while we remediate. Need eng + product signoff.
Tom: I can prototype the read-only route. We'll need to note performance variance in the runbook.
Ravi: Also propose a provider-neutral token adapter that lets us swap auth vendors more easily for critical control paths. Long-term but worth tracking.
Clara: I've scheduled a 20m sync Fri to review Tom's proto + Ravi's adapter plan. Invite sent to eng, product, and platform leads.
Aisha: Action list for the JIRA summary I will send:
- Tom: CPL-712 prototype PR by Tue, soft deploy canary by Thu
- Ravi: AUTH-503 implementation + tests by Thu EOD
- Clara: OPS-221 alerts + runbook + daily digest by tomorrow AM
- Aisha: Draft vendor-negotiation summary and SLA ask (due next Mon)
Extras: add smoke test to CI to simulate provider 5xx (example):
```
# simulate provider 5xx spike
python tests/simulate_provider_spike.py --duration 60 --rate 0.6
```
Ravi: I'll attach the jitter math and client snippet in the AUTH-503 ticket.
Tom: Will include bench notes on write latency and cost delta for batching.
Clara: Ops-bot: OPS-221 status -> in-progress (updated by Clara)
Aisha: Good progress. Keep updates here; I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and timeline after Clara's runbook is live. If anyone sees a regression, escalate to #incidents and tag me.
Ravi: :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Note: Created recurring calendar event "vendor-dep weekly pulse" every Mon for 6 weeks starting 2026-03-30.
